flap.purpose: One uppercase character per flap cell.

shadows.name: bezel-inset
shadows.purpose: Recesses the board into the housing.

shadows.name: flap-proud
shadows.purpose: Lifts each flap one pixel off the board.

shadows.name: paper-drop
shadows.purpose: Paper sheets resting on the housing.

shadows.name: key-base
shadows.purpose: The Ask key's travel; collapses to 1px when pressed.

motion.name: flap-step
motion.purpose: Split-flap turn; only changed cells move. Off under reduced motion.

components.name: Ask Key
components.description: The one filled control, cream like a flap: submits the question.
components.css: .ds-ask { font: 700 1.35rem 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #0e0f11; background: #f1ede2; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 14px 26px; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #a8a294; } .ds-ask:active { transform: translateY(2px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #a8a294; }

components.name: Flap Strip
components.css: .ds-flaps { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; font-size: 21px; } .ds-flaps span { position: relative; width: 1em; height: 1.42em; font: 600 1em/1.42em 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; text-align: center; color: #ffbe2e; background: linear-gradient(#35383d 0 50%, #2a2c31 50% 100%); border-radius: 2px; } .ds-flaps span::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 50%; height: 1px; background: rgb(0 0 0 / .7); }

components.name: Question Field
components.description: The question well, recessed like the board.
components.html: <textarea class="ds-field" rows="2">Someone cheated me of money in August 2024.</textarea>
components.css: .ds-field { width: 100%; font: 500 1.1rem/1.45 Barlow, sans-serif; color: #f1ede2; background: #0e0f11; border: 1px solid #3a3d43; border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px 14px; caret-color: #ffbe2e; }

components.name: Answer Notice
components.description: Square printed sheet under the board carrying the answer prose.
components.html:
Answer

Assuming the offence was committed in August 2024, the BNS applies.
components.css: .ds-notice { background: #eef0f2; color: #15171a; padding: 22px 24px 20px; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgb(0 0 0 / .35); font: 400 17px/1.55 Barlow, sans-serif; } .ds-notice h2 { margin: 0 0 10px; font: 700 1.35rem 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: Every section number changed on 1 July 2024; the page is a split-flap board that makes the renumbering physical. Prose lives on paper pinned beneath the board.
keyCharacteristics: Flaps turn only where a value changed

rules.name: Status Is Not The Accent
rules.body: Green, orange and red mean answered, needs a date, not covered; never decoration.

rules.name: No Glow
rules.body: Depth from the bezel inset and the flap split line only.

dos: Show every section on flaps with its counterpart
Scramble while checking, settle only changed cells
donts: No light theme or second accent
